commands.summary: Place a library symbol on a sheet, or define one in a project symbol library.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --library-id
flags.summary: The library symbol to place, LIBRARY:NAME, such as Device:R.

flags.name: --reference
flags.summary: The new reference, such as R5, or a prefix and ? for the next free number; default: the symbol's own prefix and ?.

flags.name: --value
flags.summary: The Value field; default: the library symbol's.

flags.name: --footprint
flags.summary: The Footprint field, LIBRARY:NAME; default: the library symbol's.

flags.name: --x
flags.summary: X of the symbol's anchor, with --y.
flags.coordinate_system: schematic sheet: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down; 1.27 mm grid

flags.name: --y
flags.summary: Y of the symbol's anchor, with --x.
flags.coordinate_system: schematic sheet: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down; 1.27 mm grid

flags.name: --near
flags.summary: Without --x/--y: place it beside this reference.

flags.name: --sheet
flags.summary: The sheet path to place it on, such as /power/; default: the root sheet.

flags.name: --definition
flags.summary: With a .kicad_sym --doc: the symbol as JSON, inline or a file (name, reference, body_mm, pins).

reference.description: The designator prefix, such as U.

body_mm.description: The body rectangle [width, height], centred on the origin.

at_mm.description: The connection point [x, y], y up, on the 1.27 mm grid.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Move or turn footprints on a board after a KiCad DRC check.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --id
flags.summary: Reference of an unlocked footprint, such as R1; tracks do not follow.

flags.name: --x
flags.summary: The new X position of the footprint's origin.
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --y
flags.summary: The new Y position of the footprint's origin.
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --rotation
flags.summary: The new angle about the origin, counterclockwise as KiCad shows it with y down: a pad at (dx, dy) from the origin goes to (dx*cos a + dy*sin a, -dx*sin a + dy*cos a), so at 90deg a pad 1 mm right of the origin ends 1 mm above it. Such as 90deg.

flags.name: --input
flags.summary: A JSON file, or - for stdin, with several moves and one DRC check: {"items": [{"id": "R1", "x": "12.5mm", "y": "30mm", "rotation": "90deg"}, ...]}. Every value goes in the items; give no other flag but --doc.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Add a straight track or a path of straight segments after a KiCad DRC check.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --net
flags.summary: The net name, as the board has it.

flags.name: --layer
flags.summary: The copper layer, such as F.Cu; no vias or arcs.

flags.name: --width
flags.summary: The track width; default: the net class's track width.

flags.name: --x1
flags.summary: X of the start of one segment, with --y1, --x2 and --y2.
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --y1
flags.summary: Y of the start.
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --x2
flags.summary: X of the end.
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --y2
flags.summary: Y of the end.
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --points
flags.summary: Instead of --x1..--y2, a path through these corners: [{"x_mm": 10, "y_mm": 20}, ...].
flags.coordinate_system: board: origin at the top-left corner of the page, x to the right, y down, in mm

flags.name: --input
flags.summary: A JSON file, or - for stdin, with several tracks and one DRC check: {"items": [{"net": "GND", "layer": "F.Cu", "width": "0.5mm", "points": [...]}, ...]}. Every value goes in the items; give no other flag but --doc.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

flags.summary: The copper layer, such as B.Cu.

flags.name: --points
flags.summary: The outline corners in order, at least 3: [{"x_mm": 10, "y_mm": 10}, ...]. KiCad clips the fill to the board outline and fills with its default settings: 0.5 mm from other copper, at least 0.25 mm wide, and thermal reliefs with a 0.5 mm gap and 0.5 mm spokes.
